caption:
Living in thongs all summer? Here's when they're fine and when your feet might prefer a shoe.

Thongs are usually fine for the beach, the pool and quick errands. The catch is longer walks: your toes have to grip every step to keep them on, which can tire your feet and calves.

For long walks, uneven paths or lots of standing, try a sandal with a heel strap or a cushioned shoe. Went from runners all year to thongs all summer? Build up thong time gradually.

Heel pain with your first steps in the morning, or a sore spot on top of the foot, is worth getting checked. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help. Book online via the link in bio.
